_comment: Epoxy — Hermes Agent Free-Tier Proxy. Pools multiple Groq + Ollama Cloud API keys behind a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint with automatic rotation and cooldown handling.
name: Epoxy
author: epoxy@users.noreply.github.com
description:
Epoxy pools multiple free-tier Groq and Ollama Cloud API keys behind a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint with automatic rotation and cooldown handling.

API keys are stored in /home/container/.env. After creating the server, go to the File Manager, open .env, and paste your comma-separated API keys. Then restart the container (or just send a request — keys reload automatically on change).

Point Hermes Agent at this proxy:
  custom_providers:
    free-pool:
      base_url: http://<server-ip>:{{SERVER_PORT}}

Then in Hermes: /model groq-llama-3.1-8b-instant or /model ollama-deepseek-v3.1

Pool strategies:
  fill_first  — drain first healthy key before moving on
  round_robin — cycle evenly across all healthy keys (default)
  least_used  — pick the key with fewest requests
  random      — random selection among healthy keys

Cooldowns: 429→1h, 402→24h, 401→immediate rotation

installation.script:
echo "Epoxy — all dependencies baked into the image."
echo "After install, edit /home/container/.env via File Manager"
echo "to add your GROQ_API_KEYS and/or OLLAMA_API_KEYS."
echo "Then restart the server."

variables.name: Groq Pool Strategy
variables.description: Key selection strategy: fill_first, round_robin, least_used, random.

variables.name: Ollama Pool Strategy
variables.description: Key selection strategy: fill_first, round_robin, least_used, random.

variables.name: Startup Command
variables.description: Leave at default. Entrypoint handles port via SERVER_PORT env.
